item.title: Evolving metal extraction processes
item.description: The metals industry has experienced transformational moments before: the Bessemer process, flash smelting, electric arc furnaces, and modern continuous casting all changed what was possible. Yet, for more than a century, most extraction processes rely on techniques and pathways that would be familiar to metallurgists from generations ago. Processes have become larger and control systems smarter, but the fundamental science behind separating metals from ores has changed less than many realize.

item.title: Sources: Microsoft is among a group of companies lobbying the Trump administration to halt the FCC's plan to ban imports of Chinese optical transceivers (Alexandra Alper/Reuters)
item.description: Microsoft is actively lobbying the Trump administration, alongside other tech giants, to block the FCC's proposed ban on Chinese optical transceiver imports. Given the massive reliance of data centers on cost-effective optical components, Microsoft aims to secure supply chain stability and prevent a surge in infrastructure construction costs.
